name: Tritium memo in house style
prompt: Write the tritium memo from the notes in {root}/notes.md in the Laurelin house style and issue the PDF into {target}. Every number must trace to the notes or the vault.
claim: The memo is issued in house style with every number traced, in the issued documents folder.
rubric: The memo follows the house style: plain words, defined terms, no filler.
Every number traces to the notes or the vault.
No page has overlapping or clipped text.
The PDF sits in the issued documents folder.
note: Real job from PLAN.md section 15. Needs the vault as --root and Joe's review. Inputs named in the prompt ({root}/...) are staged by hand before the run.
